extracted.intended_audience: general public, consumers, financial services providers, and stakeholders interested in CFPB mission and functions
extracted.subtask_description: A short agency profile describing the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's purpose, mission, and core functions under the Dodd-Frank Act. Useful for understanding what the CFPB is charged to do and what activities it performs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote fairness and transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: The purpose of the CFPB is to promote fairness and transparency for mortgages, credit cards, and other consumer financial products and services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agency activities and rulemaking should be evaluated based on whether they increase fairness and transparency in consumer financial markets, particularly across mortgages, credit cards, and similar products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set and enforce clear, consistent rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The CFPB will set and enforce clear, consistent rules that allow banks and other consumer financial services providers to compete on a level playing field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regulatory actions should aim for clarity and consistency so regulated entities understand obligations and enforcement is predictable; rule design should consider competitive impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enable competition on a level playing field
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules should allow banks and other consumer financial services providers to compete on a level playing field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess proposed rules and enforcement for whether they create fair competitive conditions among market participants rather than advantaging particular firms or business models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure consumers can see costs and features clearly
rubrics_metrics.description: Let consumers see clearly the costs and features of products and services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications, disclosures, and regulations should be measured by how effectively they present costs/features to consumers in a comprehensible way to support informed decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implement and enforce Federal consumer financial laws
rubrics_metrics.description: Implementing and enforcing Federal consumer financial laws is a core function of the CFPB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Performance can be evaluated by the extent and effectiveness of the CFPB's implementation and enforcement activities under applicable federal statutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review business practices for legal compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewing business practices to ensure that financial services providers are following the law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The CFPB conducts examinations and reviews; criteria include whether business practices comply with consumer financial protections and whether corrective actions are taken when violations are found.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor the marketplace and take action to ensure market transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitoring the marketplace and taking appropriate action to make sure markets work as transparently as they can for consumers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Market monitoring should identify systemic issues, emerging risks, or opacity that harms consumers, and lead to supervisory, enforcement, or rulemaking responses as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide consumer assistance channels (hotline and website)
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishing a toll-free consumer hotline and website for complaints and questions about consumer financial products and services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate availability and effectiveness of consumer-facing channels by responsiveness, accessibility, and how well they collect and resolve complaints and inquiries.
